title: Queue Capability Profile
description: Discovery root for contract: durable-queue/v0. One backend's declaration of what it supports, split into immutable build facts and effective runtime facts. A profile with origin 'harness' was produced by running the conformance vectors; a profile with origin 'declared' is an unverified claim.

capabilities.description: Host-less capability tokens. Must include the exact opaque durable-queue contract token.

backend.description: Backend family identifier (for example an embedded log, a SQL dialect, a broker, or a cloud queue).

origin.description: harness: produced by the conformance harness from observed runs. declared: hand-written claim, not evidence.

conformance.description: deterministic: virtual clock, exact normalized ledger match. tolerant: wall clock, event order and type match only.

ledger.description: recorded: each transition appends its ledger event in the same atomic step. inferred: the adapter reconstructs events from backend state; not suitable for audit.

idempotency_window_ms.description: How long a repeated idempotency_key is recognized. Absent means the backend does not deduplicate.

buildFacts.description: Immutable facts about the built artifact. A cgo-free or C-free build label says nothing about durability; see runtime.

target.description: Build target triple or platform identifier.

native_dependencies.description: Non-host-language native dependencies linked or loaded (C libraries, extensions). Empty means none.

runtimeFacts.description: Effective facts for the configuration that was exercised. enabled_capabilities must be a subset of build.compiled_capabilities (normative rule).

durability.description: Commit acknowledgement boundary. An acknowledged enqueue survives process loss under fsync_each_commit and group_commit; os_buffered survives process loss but not power loss; none makes no claim.

configuration_digest.description: Optional digest of the effective configuration, for binding a profile to a harness run.
